label: Four standalone bash tests exist in runtime/cli/tests (check-ac-closure.sh, check-ac-coverage.sh, check-graph-metadata-child-drift.sh, check-graph-metadata-shape-last-active-child.sh) that are named by no vitest file, no package.json script (test:validation verified at package.json:22), no reference from test-validation-extended.sh, and no CI step read; if npm run test:legacy does not dispatch them, they are dead tests that rotted unseen — the exact failure mode the CI comment at spec-kit-check.yml:55-56 describes for the legacy lanes.

rules/check-links.sh is the only rule script with no validator-registry.json row (39 rows checked; 27 rules/*.sh listed), so the validation lane never runs it; its only live caller is .opencode/hooks/post-edit-quality/lib/post-edit-router.cjs. Consistent with the round-two census row 10, recorded not re-listed as a defect.
